title: Chapter 456
paragraphs: Chapter 456
Episode 130: New Year, False Rumors, and Major Construction (5)
They immediately moved to the temporary healing room set up in the basement of the mansion.
The reason for setting up the healing room in the basement was none other than the fact that the remnants of Zephyrin's poison in the Black Knight's body were contaminating the air.
As they opened the door leading to the basement, a pungent smell rose. It was the smell of the poison that Kujan had extracted from the Black Knight.
“Have you arrived, Duke?”
Kujan spoke with a tired face. Beside him, the top healers sent by Lani and the Phantom Squad's poison experts were exhausted and collapsed.
Nearly two weeks had passed since the New Year began. The Black Knight had just woken up, so they must have hardly had a proper sleep.
“Jett, take the healers to the rest area. And increase the amount of gold going to the Holy Kingdom this month by five times.”
Although five times the usual amount would account for more than 30% of the Holy Kingdom's annual budget, there was no need to worry about money.

The bigger the issue about Jin became, the more items from the Gold Top were sold as if they had grown wings. Considering Lani's recent achievements, it wouldn't be a waste to give them fifty times more, not just five times.
After the news broke that the 12th Rune Kandel class had taken on the Black King Corps, the merchants of the Gold Top smelled money like ghosts.
They began to produce and sell "Limited Edition Black Dragon Murakan Cosmetics" in luxury and regular versions.

Moreover, the Gold Set tribe deliberately limited the number of sales to increase the value of the limited edition. As a result, stores had long lines of customers every day, and the limited editions were traded at dozens of times the original price on the black market.
Then, those who couldn't get the limited edition flocked to other products. Products like air fresheners, soaps, and even indoor slippers with images of Jin and Murakan.
All of these were selling like hotcakes, so money was pouring in like a waterfall.
“Yes, my lord!”
“Kujan, you should go up and rest too. You can even take a two-day break with Beris somewhere quiet.”
“I'll take a vacation after the construction is finished, Duke.”
“Anyway, Kujan, this friend is a workaholic, haha. Then let's have a drink with me tonight. I'll ask my Balcas Knight and Lata Knight as well.”
Kujan, Jett, and the healers left the basement.
Creak.
As they opened the door, they saw the Black Knight sitting on the bed.
As Quicantel had told them on the way, he still couldn't fully control his body. However, detoxification was now over, and all he needed was medicine, rest, and time.
“Black Knight.”
As Jin approached, the Black Knight slowly lifted his head.
He looked dazed, like someone who had just woken up from a dream. Even a 10-star strong body would not regain its energy so easily after such strong poison and medicine had ravaged it for two weeks.
“No, is it okay to call you Dox McRolan?”
Dox McRolan.
That was the name they had learned while he was unconscious.

They couldn't find the exact personal information of the Black Knight with the authority of the 12th class. Only those who have been recognized as a 4th class or an equivalent rank can access the personal information of an active Black Knight.
However, there was no need to request information from another member of the family to find out Dox's name, as he had done with Barton.
That's because he was a member of the Gilli family.
"12th generation..."

Dox licked his lips and looked around. He reflexively searched for a weapon, but the sound of chains rattling came from his arms and legs. They were specially made chains that had been tied up as a precaution.
Jin untied the chains.
"I never imagined the Black Knight would be in such a vulnerable state. You probably feel the same."
Dox just stared at Jin in silence.
This was not to choose a response, but to sort out the remaining poison in his body. It was also a time to recall the past memories he hadn't been able to review since waking up.
'What the hell happened? Damn, the Black Helmet is in this kind of shape...!'
He clearly remembered the moment he was ambushed by Zephrin, the strange mercenary.
The creepy sensation of the sudden purple fingernails piercing his body came to mind, making him shudder once more.
However, his memories of the events that followed were as chaotic as broken glass.
'He lost consciousness immediately due to an unfamiliar poison. The mercenary kept attacking, and I couldn't stop it because of the extreme poison. I thought I was going to die.'
If Jin and his group had not been there, Dox would have met a clean death with the additional attacks that followed the ambush.
'And then... suddenly, a strange space was formed, and the 12th generation, Murakan, and the Black King's Squad protected me and fought.'
The 12th generation saved me. Dox was easily able to come to that conclusion.
But then why? Dox didn't know how the subsequent battle between Jin's group, the Black King's Squad, and Zephrin had unfolded.
And if someone had the ability to finish him in one blow, it would have been absolutely difficult for the 12th generation and the guardian dragon to fight while protecting him.
So, the 12th generation should have abandoned him and run away. Especially since they were in a sharp confrontation with the 2nd generation.
'Was it a decision for the family, beyond the confrontation with the 2nd generation? It's possible if they used the Black King's Squad as a shield...'
Did the 12th generation risk their lives to save him, which means for the family, despite it being an act of helping the 2nd generation?
Suddenly, a headache tore through Dox's mind.
"Don't try to force yourself to sort out the poison. I have no intention of torturing you for information on the 2nd generation or holding you as a prisoner, so relax."
Jin pulled up a chair and sat down in front of Dox.
"Of course, torture wouldn't be enough to make the Black Knight talk, and if captured as a prisoner, Joshua wouldn't come to save you anyway."
"Did you... save me?"
"Yes. Murakan, the Black King's Party, and I fought that monster to protect you."
"Huoo."
"After the escape, the Holy King personally treated you at my request."
Up to this point, it wasn't difficult for Dox to imagine the sequence of events. Everyone in Runecandel knew about Jin and Lani's relationship.
However, at Jin's next words, Dox, as the Black Knight, couldn't help but widen his eyes and flinch.
"But even Lani couldn't fully heal you. So, we opened the Eternal Warehouse and used the last remaining drop of Numelus's blood in the Holy Kingdom."
Choking! Cough!
Dox was on the verge of coughing due to embarrassment. It was the first time he had coughed like this since becoming the Black Knight.

"You must know best, being in that extreme poison. No matter how great the Holy King's divine power is, that poison was not something that could be cured. Even after using Numelus's blood, it took you almost half a month to wake up."
"Ah, I see."
"Does it sound like a lie?"
Jin looked into Dox's eyes as he spoke.
Of course, it was a lie.
Numelus's blood had never been used. Dox had recovered solely through Lani's divine power and the abilities of the Holy Kingdom.

However, Dox couldn't doubt it. It wasn't strange at all to think that it was a poison that couldn't be cured without using something like Numelus's blood, as Jin said. He had never used it, and there was no one to tell him that it had been used on him.
"Why, anyway? I can express my gratitude as a member of the family, but do you think I'll swear loyalty to you for using such a miracle?"
He was a Black Knight. The Black Knights weren't so shallow as to betray their lord just because someone saved their life.
Then, Jin chuckled. It wasn't something Jin had said to get Dox's loyalty; it was just a harmless lie.
"Loyalty? Well, I didn't expect that much from you. Look at this and let's talk."
Jin handed over a bundle of newsletters.
They were newsletters praising Jin and Murakan, written by Joshua's penmen.

'What is this... These are definitely newsletters from the 2nd generation's press. Did the 2nd generation order these articles with this tone? Moreover, there is no mention of Jephilin in any of the articles. It's full of content that the 12th generation and the Guardian Dragon took over the Black King's Party.'
There were so many things he couldn't understand as soon as he opened his eyes.
However, the meaning of these articles was clear.

'The 12th generation didn't use me to make a deal with the 2nd generation. The 2nd generation thinks I'm dead. And the 12th generation judged that even if they gave wings to the 2nd generation, this is the path for the family.'
Dox believed that he knew Joshua better than anyone else.
It wasn't entirely wrong. He had always served as the Black Knight close to Joshua after joining him with the consent of the family head and acting family head.
"Is there any need for me to explain why Joshua released these articles?"
"…I think I get it. Jephirin escaped, and you took the credit for bringing down Heukwangdan. The second generation doesn't know the truth, so they published these articles."
"That's right. But even if you tell Joshua about Jephirin's existence, nothing will change. And even if you go back, Joshua won't trust you anymore."
The Joshua that Jin thought of was that kind of person.
He wouldn't trust anyone who had once escaped his control, no matter the reason.
Especially when a supposedly dead Heukgisah (Black Knight) returns, saying that a new recruit of Heukwangdan ambushed him, and the twelfth generation saved him...?

'For Joshua, it's a disruption to his calculations. He's already factored in the loss of a Heukgisah, prioritizing the family's power and interests. More than anything, trusting a Heukgisah that was saved and returned is impossible.'
- Losing a Heukgisah is unspeakably painful, but the family must gain the maximum benefit from this situation.
This was what Joshua said while conversing with Howard.
Jin hadn't heard it directly, but his calculations about Joshua were accurate.
"…Think as you please. What are you going to do with me now?"

"What am I going to do? I'll send you back to Joshua. Whether he trusts you again or not, you won't betray him anyway. Joshua and I are fighting for hierarchy, but in a broader sense, you're a crucial force for the family. That's why I even used the sacred blood to save you."
"Are you serious?"
"Yes, I'm serious. But before that, I must receive the payment for saving you. Before going to Joshua, as soon as your body recovers, fulfill one of my commands."
Doks looked up at Jin.
A sudden command, he couldn't quickly figure out what the twelfth generation's intention was.
"I'll let you know that it's up to you whether to carry out the command or not. However, if you don't… after I gain control of the family, you'll have to bear whatever consequences come."
"You talk as if you'll definitely become the family head."
"People don't know what will happen, right? What will you do? It shouldn't be a difficult command, nothing compared to the value of a Heukgisah's life."
There was no immediate reason for Doks to refuse.
If he refused and Jin changed his attitude, there would be no answer.
He could decide whether to carry out the command after recovering and leaving this place.
"Fine, I accept. Tell me what the command is."
At those words, Jin smiled slyly.
"As soon as you recover, head to the city of Licalton in the southern region of Huphester. Investigate the truth behind the events occurring in Licalton."
Licalton.
That was the land suspected to be where Joshua procured the 'human materials' for his cloning.
